# davinci-resolve-mcp
> FastMCP 3.1+ server for DaVinci Resolve automation. 9 portmanteau tools, 38 individual tools, CLI commands.

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.

## Docs
- [Readme](README.md): Main readme
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Release history
- [Install](INSTALLATION.md): Installation guide
- [Architecture](docs\ARCHITECTURE.md): Fleet standards and layout
- [Usage](docs\USAGE.md): MCP clients, env, config
- [Resolve API](docs\DAVINCI_RESOLVE.md): Resolve scripting API setup

## API
- [Routes](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\api\routes.py): FastAPI routes
- [Server](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\server.py): FastMCP server entry

## Tools
- [Portmanteau Init](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\portmanteau\__init__.py): 9 consolidated tools
- [Project Tools](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\project_tools.py): Project CRUD
- [Media Tools](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\media_tools.py): Media import/pool
- [Timeline Tools](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\timeline_tools.py): Timeline + markers + keyframes
- [Color Tools](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\color_tools.py): Color grading + gallery stills
- [Render Tools](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\render_tools.py): Render queue
- [Audio Tools](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\audio_tools.py): Audio effects/levels
- [Fairlight Tools](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\fairlight_tools.py): Fairlight page + EQ + sends + buses
- [Subtitle Tools](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\subtitle_tools.py): Subtitles + SRT import/export
- [Help Tool](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\tools\help_tool.py): Multi-level help system
- [Agentic](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\agentic.py): Agentic workflow orchestration

## CLI Entry
- [Main](src\davinci_resolve_mcp\main.py): Typer CLI (start, mcp, web, check, run-script, render, import-media, open-project)

- [Examples](examples/): Example code and configurations
